integrity: Theorem establishes exactly two simple positive covariance-isotropy reset rates for each positive trap and angular diffusion rate. Algebraic proof and finite numerical checks are provided. No independent audit or experimental validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary centered second moments only, common simultaneous position-and-heading reset clock, k,d,v,r>0 and D>=0; not full distributional isotropy. Original stationary moment identities appear in arXiv:2409.06920. The present two-crossing classification and asymptotics are derived from them; broader prior coverage may exist.
title: Two reentrant covariance-isotropy rates for a harmonically trapped resetting active Brownian particle
